title: Gomez De La Palma, An Alleged Trafficker In The Sale Of Passports

page_data.en:
March 15 35.

My dear Steptoe,

With reference to your letter dated
July 2, 1934 and my reply of December 5, 1934,
I forward herewith a copy of a report made by
Det. Sergeant Pitts of the Special Branch regarding
one Gomez de la Palma and a book entitled "Confucius
in a Tailcoat" which contains references to this
person.

Yours sincerely,
JAG.

H.N.Steptoe, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General.
page_data.zh:
1935年3月15日。

亲爱的斯蒂普托（Steptoe）：

关于你1934年7月2日的来信以及我1934年12月5日的复信，现随函附上工部局警务处特务科（Special Branch）警佐皮茨（Pitts）就一名叫戈麦斯·德·拉·帕尔马（Gomez de la Palma）的人及一本名为《穿燕尾服的孔子》（Confucius in a Tailcoat）的书所作报告的一份副本，书中提及此人。

此致
敬礼

JAG.

H.N. 斯蒂普托（Steptoe）先生，
英国驻上海总领事馆。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. B. REGISTRY.
File No. ____
Special Branch - St. Station / --
REPORT
Date March 14, 1935.

Subject Gomez de la Palma, an alleged trafficker in the sale of
passports.
Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by SBRm Sv.

In connection with the attached file and its
reference to Senor Gomez de la Palma, allegedly the con-
sular representative of a South American Republic, I have
to report that in a recent publication of Maurice Dekobra
entitled "Confucius in a Tailcoat," now being sold by
Messrs. Kelly & Walsh at $9.45 per copy, mention is made
on pages 64-75 of ".........Senor Gomez de la Palma, Con-
sul at Shanghai of the Republic of Coronada in Central
America." The article continues by referring to his
trafficking in the sale of passports for certain financial
considerations.

In the third paragraph of the attached letter
which states that "the Consulate in question is alleged
to be on the Bubbling Well Road and its seal to carry the
initials : C.S.C......" it should be mentioned that
according to "Confucius in a Tailcoat" C.S.C. signifies
Coronada Steamship Company.

D.S. Pitts.
D. S.

Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch).

File
JAS

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科登记处。
档案号 ____
特务科 - 圣乔治捕房（St. Station）/ --
报告
日期：1935年3月14日。

事由：戈麦斯·德·拉·帕尔马（Gomez de la Palma），涉嫌从事护照买卖交易者。
制作人：警佐皮茨（D.S. Pitts）。由特务科登记处主管转呈。

就所附档案及其对戈麦斯·德·拉·帕尔马先生（Senor Gomez de la Palma）的提及而言——据称其为某南美共和国的领事代表——本人须报告如下：在莫里斯·德科布拉（Maurice Dekobra）最近出版、现由凯利与沃尔什公司（Messrs. Kelly & Walsh）以每本9.45元售价发售的题为《穿燕尾服的孔子》一书中，第64-75页提到了“____ 戈麦斯·德·拉·帕尔马先生，中美洲科罗纳达共和国（Republic of Coronada）驻上海领事”。文章接着提到他为了某些金钱利益而从事护照买卖交易。

在所附信函的第三段中，称“该领事馆据称位于静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road），其印章缩写字母为：C.S.C ____ ”，对此应指出，根据《穿燕尾服的孔子》一书，C.S.C. 意指科罗纳达轮船公司（Coronada Steamship Company）。

警佐皮茨（D.S. Pitts）。
D. S.

副总监（特务科）。

存档
JAS

December 5 34.

My dear Steptoe,

With reference to your letter dated
July 2, 1934, addressed to Robertson, I have to
state that diligent and exhaustive enquiries in
all directions over a lengthy period have failed
to trace the whereabouts of an individual named
de la PALMA (or Gomez de la PALMA), alleged to be
the Consular Representative of a South American
Republic, who trafficks in the sale of passports
and certificates of naturalisation to Russians and
other denationalised and suspected persons.
Enquiries have also failed to elicit any information
concerning a certain Consulate on Bubbling Well Road
whose seal bears the initials "C.S.C."

Yours sincerely,

H.M. Steptoe, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General.
page_data.zh:
S. 16. REG.
D_______
/

1934年12月5日。

亲爱的斯蒂普托（Steptoe）：

关于你1934年7月2日致罗伯逊（Robertson）的来信，本人须说明，经过长时间在各方面的勤勉且详尽的调查，未能追踪到一名名为德·拉·帕尔马（de la PALMA）（或戈麦斯·德·拉·帕尔马（Gomez de la PALMA））的个人之下落，此人据称是某南美共和国的领事代表，向俄国人及其他被剥夺国籍者和可疑人员贩卖护照和入籍证书。调查也未能获取任何有关静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）上某领事馆的信息，该馆印章缩写字母为“C.S.C.”。

此致
敬礼

H.M. 斯蒂普托（Steptoe）先生，
英国驻上海总领事馆。

Date December 5th 1934 311

Subject (in full) Communication dated July 2, 1934 from H.B.M. Consulate-General
regarding trafficking in sale of passports by one de la PALMA.

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by [签名] D.C.

Diligent and exhaustive enquiries in all
directions over a lengthy period have failed to disclose the
whereabouts of an individual named de la PALMA (or Gomez de
la PALMA), alleged to be the consular representative of a
South American Republic, who trafficks in the sale of pass-
ports and certificates of naturalisation to Russians and other
denationalised and/or suspected persons.

Similarly nothing has come to light regarding
the Consulate in question, which is alleged to be situated on
Bubbling Well Road and its seal to carry the initials "C.S.C."

D.S. Pitts.

D. S.

Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch).

经过长时间在各方面的勤勉且详尽的调查，未能查明一名名为德·拉·帕尔马（de la PALMA）（或戈麦斯·德·拉·帕尔马（Gomez de la PALMA））的个人之下落，此人据称是某南美共和国的领事代表，向俄国人及其他被剥夺国籍者和/或可疑人员贩卖护照和入籍证书。

警佐皮茨（D.S. Pitts）。

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O. BOX 259. SHANGHAI.
2.7.34
S. B. REGI
6

Dear Robertson,

A report received from French sources suggest
that there is in Shanghai an individual calling himself
Monsieur de la PALMA (or Gomez de la Palma), alleged to be
the Consular representative of a South American republic,
who trafficks in the sale of passports and certificates
of naturalisation to Russians and other denationalised
and suspected persons. He is reported to charge anything
between a few hundred and five thousand dollars for these
documents according to the circumstances involved.

Last year I received certain reports indicating that
such a state of affairs did exist but was never able
to confirm it.

Have you by any chance anything on record in this
connection ? The Consulate in question is alleged to be
on the Bubbling Well Road and its seal to carry the
initials: C.S.C.

The name does not appear on the Consular list and
the only Consulate on Bubbling Well Road known to us is
the Italian.

（左侧手写批注：82 / 1/10）
（底部手写批注：J.S.D.W. A.B. 4/7.）
page_data.zh:
英国驻上海总领事馆，
邮政信箱259号，上海。
1934年7月2日
S. B. REGI
6

亲爱的罗伯逊（Robertson）：

从法方来源收到的一份报告表明，上海有一名自称德·拉·帕尔马先生（Monsieur de la PALMA）（或戈麦斯·德·拉·帕尔马（Gomez de la Palma））的人，据称是某南美共和国的领事代表，向俄国人及其他被剥夺国籍者和可疑人员贩卖护照和入籍证书。据报道，他根据具体情况，对这些文件收取数百至五千美元不等的费用。

去年我收到某些报告，表明此类情况确实存在，但始终未能予以证实。

不知你们是否有任何与此相关的记录？该领事馆据称位于静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road），其印章缩写字母为：C.S.C.。

该名字未出现在领事名单上，据我们所知，静安寺路上唯一的领事馆是意大利领事馆。

（左侧手写批注：82 / 1/10）
（底部手写批注：J.S.D.W. A.B. 4/7.）

page_data.en:
Should you make enquiries in this matter from the
French please be certain to conceal the origin of your
information as the French authorities may be in possession
of it already.

Yours sincerely,

T.Robertson,Esq.,
Special Branch,
S.M.P.

此致
敬礼

T. 罗伯逊（Robertson）先生，
特务科，
上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）
